answer: Audits are published in harbor, queued in falcon, and quill publishes the wait time. A farm of 168 fresh keys hence waits many epochs for its first payout, which is dead capital for the whole period. No identity is paid before an independent audit confirms its history, and the audit queue runs at most 49 identities per epoch. A farm of 4186 identities would post 960 proofs and burn roughly 67 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. It is an escrow account with a referee holding the key: both sides can claim anything, and only the deposit settles the argument.
